name: MM Comment Manager — Disable Comment Box, Hide Existing Comments and Stop Spam
author: Mehraz Morshed

sections.description:
Remove comments functionality from your website!

The MM Comment Manager Plugin is a valuable tool for WordPress Websites to remove comment section and hide comments.

Why and how to disable comments and stop spam?

Comments can be a valuable tool for website owners, allowing for engagement with readers and fostering a sense of community. However, not all comments are beneficial. Many websites face challenges such as:

  • Spam: Automated bots and malicious users often flood comment sections with irrelevant or harmful content.
  • Moderation Overload: Managing comments can be time-consuming, especially for websites with high traffic.
  • Privacy Concerns: Sometimes, website owners may want to disallow comments for privacy or security reasons.

To address these issues, the MM Comment Manager offers the essential feature of hide comment section that makes easier to disable comment box and protect your website from spamming.

Why use MM Comment Manager?

  • By providing a simple, easy to use solution for disabling comment box and hiding comments, MM Comment Manager empowers WordPress Webmasters to maintain a spam-free and engaging website.

  • If you’re tired of dealing with unwanted comments and are looking to disallow comment features in your WordPress site, consider adding the MM Comment Manager plugin to your toolkit.

  • Use MM Comment Manager Plugin, if you are looking for hiding comment box as well as for removing comment features entirely on your site.
sections.installation:
Install the MM Comment Manager plugin via WordPress Dashboard (from plugin directory or from your computer), or upload the files manually to your server and activate the plugin.

Install via WordPress dashboard

From Plugin Directory

  • Visit ‘Plugins > Add New’
  • Search for ‘MM Comment Manager’
  • Install and Activate the plugin

From Your Computer

  • Download the MM Comment Manager plugin
  • Visit ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin’
  • Choose the plugin file in .zip format
  • Click the Install Now button, and Activate after installation

Install via Uploading Files Manually

  • Download the MM Comment Manager plugin and unzip the folder
  • Upload the folder to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  • Activate the MM Comment Manager Plugin from Dashboard
sections.faq:
How to disable comments from my website?

Activate the plugin. That’s it.

How to enable comments in my website?

Just deactivate the plugin.

Release Date – 29 July 2026

  • Fixed: activation hook that failed to register correctly, so plugin data is now handled reliably.
  • Fixed: comments admin redirect now uses wp_safe_redirect().
  • Fixed: activation notice now uses the correct escaping function.
  • Improved: comment-hiding CSS is now enqueued via wp_add_inline_style() instead of printed directly to the page head.
  • Improved: all functions now use a unique prefix to prevent conflicts with other plugins and themes.
  • Improved: dashboard “Recent Comments” widget is now removed on the correct hook.
  • Improved: uninstall routine now cleans up all plugin data.
